basis.note: The benchmark profiles are logical/CSS-pixel fixtures. Actual materialized widthMm/heightMm remains the preferred authority in V2. Pixel counts below conservatively use ceil after conversion.

profiles.roundingNote: The exact mathematical CSS conversion lands essentially on 1100/1375 horizontally; the research utility intentionally uses conservative ceil over floating/measured-mm input, yielding one pixel of headroom.

fourXVs300.interpretation: A 4x CSS-derived master corresponds to 384 DPI and therefore carries about 28% linear / 64% raster-area headroom over a 300-DPI physical-use target. This is acceptable as a research fixture but is not evidence that 4x should be a product contract.

reuseDecision.reason: A derivative may have enough pixels for another placement while its aspect/composition/semantic framing remains inappropriate there.
reuseDecision.default: Keep catalog derivatives placement-local; explicit promotion/reuse requires fidelity plus composition compatibility, not only raster sufficiency.
